quote: Sirius may engage any subprocessor it deems appropriate without prior notice to or consent from the customer.
policy_quote: Vendor must notify us in writing at least 30 days before adding a new subprocessor. Violation: no notice requirement, or notice <30 days.
reason: There is no notice requirement at all. The policy lists that as a violation.
suggested_fix: Require at least 30 days' prior written notice before a new subprocessor is added.
